admission_requirements.general_requirements: General secondary school certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; non-Jordanian certificates must be equivalated by the Jordanian Ministry of Education

tuition_fees.notes: Fees based on per-credit-hour rates: humanities/occupational education 80 JOD/hr, business/IT 85 JOD/hr, AI/physiotherapy/medical imaging 100 JOD/hr, engineering/pharmacy 110 JOD/hr. Annual estimates calculated from total program hours divided by program duration.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan (MOHE)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: Association of Arab Universities (since 2019), International Association of Universities (since 2020), Mediterranean Universities Union (UNIMED), AQACHEI, ASIC Accreditation

market_demand.notes: The university focuses on aligning programs with regional labor market needs in Aqaba Special Economic Zone. Specific employment rate data is not publicly available.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: University provides separate accommodation for male and female students with spacious rooms
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Full scholarships (covering tuition and registration fees) offered to students with 100% Tawjihi score; additional discounts may be available

contact_info.address: South of Aqaba, South Beach Road, Opposite Aqaba Development Corporation Stores, Aqaba, Jordan
